_comment: Meta terminal settings (console v2; proposal 19, then full trust, proposal 58). Provisioned to /var/lib/hqconsole/meta/meta-settings.json, root-owned. Capri runs like every other console terminal: bypassPermissions, no prompts, no deny list, launched with --dangerously-skip-permissions (the owner, 2026-10-11). The settings-integrity hook is unwired, because it existed only to protect the per-action prompt. The audit hook stays as the record of what the session did. Only this file is loaded (--setting-sources ''), so model is pinned here. Absolute paths only: this file is loaded outside the hq project dir.
